name: The Lost Breed - 8 Week Shred
author: The Lost Breed (thelostbreed.com)
description: Transcribed from "New Shred Program.pdf": 8 weeks / 4 phases, 6 training days per week with supersets, progression & drop sets and post-workout cardio circuits.

guide.x: 8 weeks, 4 phases of 2 weeks. Mon Shoulders, Tue Arms, Wed Legs, Thu Chest, Fri Back, Sat Abs & Cardio, Sun rest. Every strength day ends with a post-workout cardio circuit. Intensity rises each phase.
Exercises in one group alternate A → B (→ C) → A → B… Rest when the whole round is finished; push yourself not to rest during the superset.
Keep rest just long enough to recover for the target reps: 30-45 seconds. Cardio circuits: 1 minute after each A-B-C set.

Reps go down as weight goes up: aim to add 5-10 lb every set. If you miss the reps, rest the weight a few seconds and finish the set. Some sets keep the same reps but still ask for more weight each set.
After heavy sets, drop the weight about 10-15 lb and go to failure. "Double drop-set" = repeat that twice back to back. A "→" in the reps (e.g. 20→8) means one set made of two weights.
"10+10" = two parts back to back in one set (e.g. wide grip then close grip). "20 s" = timed set. FAIL = to failure. Pick weights that let you fail at the suggested rep range, never sacrifice form.
The PDF names Tuesday and Thursday as HIIT days but only lists the post-workout cardio circuits - no separate HIIT workout - so none is scheduled here.
Do abs at least 3 times a week after training. Day 6 is a full abs circuit; the Program tab also has the PDF's 10 ab circuits to tack on.
Each workout should take at least 1 - 1.5 hours.
